semantics.note: The proposition preserves the retrospective comparison, understood as progress toward an alignment solution rather than any alignment research advance.

contract.note: The broader alignment reading is ordinary in context. Requiring a connection between local advances and a general solution fairly distinguishes remaining unsolved from making no progress.

evidence.note: The contemporaneous developer research reports improved behavioral control and reduced labeling needs. It does not establish transfer to dependable general alignment.
The developer research addresses weak supervision through model experiments, but its analogy and incomplete capability recovery leave progress toward general alignment unsettled.
The contemporary assessment recognizes improved control and uncertain future controllability. It does not establish the required comparison with the 2022 baseline.

reviews.rationale: The packet documents relevant advances and continuing obstacles, but neither comparable baseline evidence nor demonstrated transfer settles whether a general alignment solution was nearer by June 2024. Continuing uncertainty does not establish no progress.

attribution.note: Marcus directly endorses the assessment of persistent technical problems.

semantics.note: Read in context as concerning contemporary generative AI, the proposition preserves persistent unreliability, toxicity, hallucinations, and the investment qualifier.

contract.note: Persistent substantive failures in generative models are a fair ordinary reading. The contract reasonably avoids implying universal failure or denying improvements.

evidence.note: The May evaluation documents task failures and hallucinated constraints or completion. Short-task successes limit the finding but do not negate persistent reliability problems.
The April benchmark reports toxicity and hallucination weaknesses in tested models. Strong GPT results and model differences preclude a claim of uniform failure, which the contract does not require.
The reported $25 billion invested in generative AI during 2023 corroborates the financial backdrop. It does not measure reliability or spending specifically on fixing it.

reviews.rationale: Contemporaneous evaluations document substantive execution failures, hallucinations, and toxicity weaknesses, while investment research confirms the stated financial backdrop. Selected successes and stronger models do not establish that these problems were resolved; the evidence does not imply failure across every model or ordinary use.
